sql:
with p as (
  select pt.market_ticker, pt.created_at, pt.pnl * 100.0 / nullif(pt.quantity, 0) c,
         split_part(pt.market_ticker, '-', 1) series
  from paper_trades pt
  where pt.strategy = 'Fmmsell10' and pt.pnl is not null and pt.created_at >= '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z'
    and pt.created_at < '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'
    and not exists (select 1 from live_orders lo where lo.strategy = 'Fmmsell10' and lo.market_ticker = pt.market_ticker)
), y as (
  select p.*, d.dim, d.bucket from p cross join lateral (values
    ('all', 'all'), ('series', series), ('week', to_char(date_trunc('week', created_at), 'MM-DD'))) d(dim, bucket)
)
select dim, bucket, count(*) n, round(avg(c)::numeric, 2) c_per, round(sum(c)::numeric / 100, 2) usd,
       round(avg(case when c < 0 then 1.0 else 0.0 end)::numeric, 3) loss_rate,
       count(distinct date_trunc('day', created_at)) days
from y group by dim, bucket having count(*) >= 10 or dim <> 'series' order by dim, n desc
